name: Submatrix Determinant Obfuscation
description: Replaces the condition of three mutually connected vertices with the mathematically equivalent condition that the 3x3 principal submatrix formed by their indices in the binary adjacency matrix has a determinant of 2. This forces the model to algebraically evaluate the determinant of a 3x3 hollow symmetric binary matrix to realize it simply requires all three off-diagonal entries to be 1, thus reducing to triangle finding.
